author: author
pageFamilies.map-source: growth map API records (the HubSpot Programs mirror) and Operations sheet rows; not a page

hubspot-programs.pageNormalization: https, host lower-cased, trailing slash added, no query or hash
hubspot-programs.note: A Program with a public type and a public website that has no page, no registry rows or no render is a finding (the coverage rows); the observer never learns a campus only from the map or the page list.

map.note: Downstream of HubSpot Programs (docs/decisions.md 2026-09-15); rows about the map compare it with HubSpot, never the other way round.

pageCheckUnmapped.edge-cache-current: compares the cached and fresh copies of one page after an edit; a ring-2 verification step, not a standing requirement
pageCheckUnmapped.header-template-present: site.header.rendered has no observer row yet (spec/observer-check-map.json requirementsWithoutObserverCoverage); the route-reachable row measures the rendered 2xx, not the template
pageCheckUnmapped.header-stylesheet-linked: same as header-template-present: a shared-template requirement without an observer row
pageCheckUnmapped.h1-present: weaker than campus.hero.identity.heading (which also requires the campus name); h1-names-campus is the mapped id
pageCheckUnmapped.cta-stay-in-the-know: label presence of a template CTA; no row measures CTA labels (spec/campus-page-requirements.json campus.hero.ctas exemplars only)
pageCheckUnmapped.cta-apply-now: same as cta-stay-in-the-know; the apply rows measure the destination, not the label
pageCheckUnmapped.n8n-synced-elements-present: site.sync.n8n-synced-elements-present is listed in spec/observer-check-map.json requirementsWithoutObserverCoverage (docs/observer-requirements.md item 6)
pageCheckUnmapped.n8n-override-recorded: a ticket-protocol bookkeeping check (an override suffix must have its APEX ticket recorded); not an observer requirement
pageCheckUnmapped.team-photo-framing: team-card framing (decision 2026-09-22) is filed as observer-layout for the elementor-owner (tests/fixtures/decisions/agent-found-team-photo-framing.json); the nearest row, site.layout.images.crop (campus-image-crop-risk, coverage of visible images), belongs to observer-media-identity, so mapping it would change the class; a framing row is still to be written

comparators.max: the measured number is at or under the threshold
comparators.count-max: the observed count is at or under the threshold; a count above detectAbove but under the threshold is telemetry
comparators.distance-max: the measured distance (comparator unit, miles for coordinates) is at or under the threshold
comparators.age-max: the measured age in hours is at or under the threshold
comparators.ratio-max: the measured ratio (0-1) is at or under the threshold
comparators.box-overlap-max: the measured box overlap (px, or share of the covered box) is at or under the threshold
comparators.count-min: the observed count is at or above the threshold
comparators.coverage-min: the covered count or share is at or above the threshold
comparators.count-equals: the observed count equals the threshold
comparators.http-status: the response status equals the threshold
comparators.equals: the observed value equals the expected value after the row's per-field normalisation
comparators.equals-url: the observed URL equals the expected URL after URL normalisation (scheme, host case, trailing slash, fragment)
comparators.equals-approved-media: the rendered intro slot's WordPress attachment id (wp-image-<id>) equals the registry attachmentId, or the registry's approved video is present; a registry entry that is missing or null is a missing expectation and files under expected.derive.onMissing; stale-launch words are evidence, never the verdict
comparators.contains: the observed text contains the expected sentence or value
comparators.not-contains: the observed text contains none of the expected words or patterns
comparators.starts-with: the observed value starts with the expected prefix
comparators.absent-after-date: the expected pattern is absent once the dated period has passed
comparators.intersects: the observed set shares at least one member with the expected set
comparators.in-set: the observed value is one of the expected values
comparators.host-in-set: the observed URL's host is one of the expected hosts
comparators.present: the expected element, link, or value is present (visible where the row says visible)
comparators.not-placeholder: the observed value is a real destination, not a placeholder
comparators.campus-identity-match: the observed text or media metadata identifies this campus and no other
comparators.only-this-campus: page-owned text and images name no other campus
comparators.valid-dates: every date value parses to a valid date
comparators.start-before-end: the start time precedes the end time
comparators.valid-json: the value parses as JSON (JSON-LD blocks)
comparators.http-2xx-after-redirects: the destination answers a 2xx status after following redirects
comparators.http-2xx-rendered: the route renders in the browser with a 2xx status and complete inspection

browser.note: a degraded browser session is reported by the loop-health rows below (route inspection, embed inspection, map inspection, every image failed)

literals.registriesNote: One finding per campus per registry whose requiredWhen.type includes the Program type and whose file has no entry at keyPath for the campus slug; the observer's finding carries missingExpectation true, registry (the registry name from the file), expected {file, keyPath}, observed (the value read), ownerRole (the entry's) and the entry's ask as its summary; the filer files it Missing Info to the entry's ownerRole (person from roleOwners) with the entry's ask and ticketClass, deduped on campus and registry. requiredWhen.type empty means informational: listed in the report, never filed.

comparator.note: One finding per campus per registry entry missing at keyPath for a registry whose requiredWhen.type includes the campus type (literals.registries); the observer emits each with missingExpectation true, registry (the registry name), expected {file, keyPath}, ownerRole and the entry ask.

A campus video is not required: campus.intro.media accepts the approved Open and Enrolling card or an approved video (registry/campus-open-media.json). The observer config already had requireOpenCampusYouTube false, so the check was inert.
Observer-internal bookkeeping (is there an approved visual baseline); no playbook requirement. Excluded from dispatch in the observer config since the start.
Observer-internal bookkeeping (are baseline screenshots present); no playbook requirement. Excluded from dispatch in the observer config since the start.

A pixel diff against an observer-held screenshot baseline (visualDiffThreshold 0.02) is not a playbook requirement; the layout rows cover the viewport rules and page-check brand-visual covers the visual brand.
Checks that the observer's own claims configuration exists; not a site requirement. The claim rows (site.claims.evidence.*) stay advisory until the claim registry is created.

'At most N primary CTAs' is an observer page policy, not a playbook requirement: campus.hero.ctas fixes the CTA row at four (page-check cta-*). Excluded from dispatch in the observer config since the start.
An audience heuristic from the observer's page policies (does a CTA lead to a prospective-family destination) with no playbook requirement behind it.
